miniapp.title: WorkPortal
miniapp.devMode: Demo mode — a browser session, not Telegram

empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.body: There is nothing to show here.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: We could not load this. Please try again.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: The connection dropped. Try again once you are back online.

forbidden.title: You do not have access
forbidden.body: This screen is for the department head. If that looks wrong, ask your head.

unlinked.title: Account not linked
unlinked.body: Your Telegram is not linked to a WorkPortal account yet. Open the Telegram section on the site and get a link code.

empty.title: Nothing for today
empty.body: Type your first item in the field above. Only you can see this list.

empty.title: You are all caught up
empty.body: No new notifications. The bot will tell you here when one arrives.

empty.title: Your column is empty
empty.body: No cards are assigned to you yet. When one is, it shows up here.

emptyTeam.title: The board is empty
emptyTeam.body: The department has no open cards yet.

card.title: Card
card.readOnly: You can read this card, but not change it.

empty.title: No upcoming events
empty.body: Nothing is planned in the department for the coming days.

missing.title: Event not found
missing.body: This event was removed, or it is not visible to you.

carpool.title: Carpool
carpool.empty: Nobody has offered a ride to this event.

focus.title: Focus
focus.botNote: The bot pings you in Telegram when the time is up. It never sends what you were working on.
focus.alertNotLinked: Telegram is not linked, so no ping was sent.
focus.alertMuted: Notifications are muted, so no ping was sent.

fields.title: My details
fields.readOnly: Your department head fills this one in.

empty.title: Nothing to fill in
empty.body: Your department has not asked you for anything.

setup.title: Telegram setup
setup.noBot: The bot is not configured yet. Your system administrator does that.
setup.linkedSummary: {linked} of {total} members linked Telegram · {groups} groups connected

bot_token.title: Bot token is set
bot_token.body: Your administrator sets TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN on the server.

bot_username.title: Bot username is known
bot_username.body: This is the name people search for to find the bot.

menu_button.title: Menu button opens the app
menu_button.body: In BotFather, point /setmenubutton at the address above.

link_self.title: Your own account is linked
link_self.body: Open the bot and send it the link code from the site.

members_linked.title: Members are linked
members_linked.body: Each person links their own account; you cannot do it for them.

group_connected.title: Department group is connected
group_connected.body: Add the bot to the group so event and poll announcements arrive there.
